observed_facts: AA-Briefcase v1.1 evaluates 91 tasks across four private multi-week projects.
Models produce task deliverables from task/project inputs; each deliverable is subsequently graded.
Grading has binary rubric checks plus pairwise analytical-quality and presentation comparisons.
A public fifth scenario demonstrates structure/submission/grading but does not count toward official results.
The four scored scenarios, including task instructions, project input files and grading rubrics, are private for evaluation integrity.
Public benchmark description separates task execution/submission from grading and scoring.
GDPval grading uses pairwise human expert preferences as the standard.
Rubrics and gold deliverables are grading resources; grading is conceptually downstream of submission.
